published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Windshaper Skyborne; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 800.7 as Tauren on the same sim)

summary: Balance with Wrath as the only filler, for a moonkin that would rather not weave.
rotation: Racials, potions and runes on cooldown. Innervate has its own condition.
Insect Swarm when it is down, with more than 8s left
Moonfire when its DoT is down, with more than 8s left
Moonfire when a Wrath plus 1.5s would not land before the end
caveats: Wrath VIII's base damage is ×1.085 the client's value.
Natural Power gloves are 8.1 DPS ahead of Arcane Power.
Subtlety 3 (Restoration) is taken for threat. It costs 2.9 / 2.9 / 3.0 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec balance with the Wrath gear variant, apl and talents; same consumes, buffs and encounter as the Balance build (shared EncounterLevel60). Duration 180s, durationVariation 20. No edits needed. Windshaper Skyborne since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29); rotation unchanged.
